column7:
Reduction in provision by
re-appropriation of
₹2,874.56 lakh was
attributed to saving due to
non-receipt of proposal.
Surrender of ₹585.91 lakh
was attributed to Repairs
and Construction of
Building of Co-operative
department. Final excess of
₹388.68 lakh is overstated
by ₹440.40 lakh due to
clearance of OB suspense
related to previous years.
Therefore, it is actual
saving of ₹51.72 lakh.
Reasons for actual saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).
